messages.body_plain:
Hello all,

If anyone's attending the AGU conference, feel free to swing by my poster (abstract # IN23D-3746 - Rnomads: An R Interface with the NOAA Operational Model Archive and Distribution System ).  I will be standing by it off and on next Tuesday afternoon.


Best,


Danny
